Hi Luca — thanks for the clear list. Attaching our AP onboarding packet and a VAT self-cert as PDFs. Summary below to help your procurement team: 

Required PO fields (minimum)
- PO number (PO-XXXX)
- Bill-to: Redwood Inference Inc. (legal name)
- Redwood tax/VAT: Redwood Inference EU Branch - VAT IT 12345678901
- SOW reference: D-3491-EU (please include in PO header and invoice line items)
- Currency and payment terms (we default to Net30 unless otherwise agreed)
- Billing contact/email: invoices@redwoodinference.com

Invoice sequencing/URN
- We recommend a stable URN prefix: RW-INF-2026-<invoice-seq>. Example: RW-INF-2026-000274
- Include the PO number in the invoice header and on each line item to assist PO matching

EU VAT / split invoices
- We can issue split invoices by country for multi-jurisdiction SOWs. Please confirm which jurisdictions you need on the PO (e.g., IT / DE / FR).
- If reverse-charge applies for a country, indicate the reverse-charge clause on the PO line item so our invoice includes the correct VAT treatment and textual note.

Attachments included:
- AP_Onboarding_Packet.pdf (vendor form, remit instructions, Redwood legal entity details)
- EU_VAT_Self-Cert.pdf (VAT registration and EU branch evidence)

Next steps / ask for procurement
1) Send completed vendor form back to invoices@redwoodinference.com
2) Upload PO with SOW reference and desired split-country breakdown
3) If you use e-invoicing, send the schema/URN requirements and we'll map to them (we support UBL/PEPPOL and custom headers)
